prompt: Create an original 180 second instrumental dub instrumental composition for rest, unwinding and breathing exercises. Mood: peaceful, soft, spacious. Instruments: round electric bass, organ, rimshot, echo guitar. Style: spacious offbeat chords with restrained tape delay. Tempo approximately 60 BPM; F major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use a restrained arrangement, soft attacks, no sudden accents. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: An upbeat electronic track featuring a catchy synth melody, supported by a steady synth bassline and electronic drums. It has a retro, chiptune-like quality.
